question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH driver_top AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, SUM(ds.points) as total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(ds.points) DESC) = 1
),
constructor_top AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(cs.points) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    dt.year,
    dr.forename || ' ' || dr.surname as driver_full_name,
    dt.total_points as driver_points,
    cons.name as constructor_name,
    ctor.total_points as constructor_points
FROM driver_top dt
JOIN constructor_top ctor ON dt.year = ctor.year
JOIN drivers dr ON dt.driver_id = dr.driver_id
JOIN constructors cons ON ctor.constructor_id = cons.constructor_id
ORDER BY dt.year
